description: Scaffolder unhooked safety harness on 5th tier (7.5m height) to adjust ledger clamp. Foot slipped, but worker caught ledger tube with hands. No fall occurred.
Electrician opened 440V distribution switchboard without performing zero voltage verification check with calibrated multi-meter. Busbars were energized.
Two workers entered nitrogen purge vessel without continuous multi-gas monitor or entry permit sign-off. Standby man was absent.
Empty plastic water bottles observed scattered near the entrance of office container walkway. Housekeeping team notified to clean.
Technician received superficial 1cm scratch on knuckle while tightening small M6 screw with flathead screwdriver. First aid bandaid applied.
